newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Aerodynamics picks David Turner as CFO.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Aerodynamics picks David Turner as CFO.

text.p: Advanced Aerodynamics & Structures Inc Thursday said it had named David Turner, 61, vice president and chief financial officer of the jet aircraft manufacturing company.
Turner, a certified public accountant, is a former senior manager of Ernst & Whinney and a former partner at Arthur Young & Co, both companies now merged as Ernst & Young.
Most recently he was vice president of finance and chief financial officer of Taitron Components Inc of Santa Clarita, Calif., Advanced Aerodynamics said in a prepared statement.
